name: Continuous Lie Group Action Framing
description: Replaces the static linear subspace spanned by difference vectors with the dynamic action of a continuous Lie group (the orthogonal group) generated by local 2D rotations (Givens rotations). The goal of containing a difference vector is replaced by the goal of finding a composite rotation that maps one basis state exactly to another. This forces the model to deduce that the invariant subspaces of the generated group correspond exactly to the connected components of the underlying graph, hiding the graph connectivity requirement behind continuous geometric transformations.
